lesson.meaning: To discuss something formally to reach an agreement or a solution.
examples: We need to negotiate a better price with our supplier for the new order.
It's important to negotiate your salary when you receive a job offer.
My kids always try to negotiate extra time for playing video games.
The manager decided to negotiate directly with the client to resolve the issue.
The two teams will meet next week to negotiate the terms of the new partnership.
lesson.memory_tip: Remember, when you 'negotiate', you're talking things through to find a solution or agreement that works for everyone!
